sip.label: SIP Telephony
sip.description: SIP trunk and voice settings. Explicit channel fields override legacy plugins.entries.sip.config; omitted fields retain legacy values.

providerPresets.description: Optional provider defaults. Built-ins merge with these presets; explicit stt/tts leaves win. No API keys in presets.

transport.description: embedded = SIP/RTP in this plugin process, bridge = consume an external Twilio-Media-Streams WebSocket (e.g. sipgate-sip-stream-bridge).

rtpPortMax.description: Must be strictly greater than rtpPortMin (runtime cross-field validation).

callerCountryCode.description: Country calling code without +; enables national caller normalization. Leave unset for E.164 only.

callerNationalPrefix.description: National trunk prefix removed before adding the configured country calling code.

toolsAllow.description: Tool names the phone agent may use. Empty disables tools (caller ID is not authentication).

promptText.default: Please enter your PIN, followed by the pound key.

model.description: Custom models accepted. Default nova-3 unless providerPresets overrides it.

baseUrl.description: WSS base URL; /v1/listen appended. Default wss://api.deepgram.com.

model.description: Custom models accepted. Default aura-2-viktoria-de for Deepgram, eleven_multilingual_v2 for ElevenLabs. Custom requires an explicit model when voice is enabled.

baseUrl.description: HTTPS base URL; provider API path appended. Custom requires an explicit URL.

voice.description: Voice identifier; required for ElevenLabs and Custom when voice.enabled (runtime validation). No default voice.

playbackPrebufferMs.description: Streaming playback prebuffer; 0 disables. Rebuffers after underrun, capped by outbound queue limit.

engine.description: openclaw: STT/TTS pipeline with OpenClaw agent. deepgram-agent: Deepgram Voice Agent runs STT, LLM and TTS itself.

tools.description: Expose openclaw_task to the Deepgram agent; runs the OpenClaw agent with inbound.toolsAllow.

sip.preset.label: SIP provider
sip.preset.help: sipgate supplies server defaults; custom requires domain and registrar under advanced settings. Existing overrides are preserved.

inbound.agentId.label: OpenClaw Agent
inbound.agentId.help: Agent ID for voice.engine openclaw and OpenClaw tool delegation from deepgram-agent. Not the Deepgram agent's own LLM model.

sip.publicIp.label: Public IP (SDP Contact)
sip.publicIp.help: Mandatory behind NAT, otherwise no RTP arrives.

audio.mode.label: Codec mode
audio.mode.help: twilio = PCMU/mu-law 8 kHz; best = G.722 16 kHz, then PCMA/PCMU. G.722 needs system SpanDSP.

stt.provider.label: Speech recognition (STT)
stt.provider.help: Select speech recognition provider. Currently Deepgram.

tts.provider.label: Speech output (TTS)
tts.provider.help: Deepgram or Custom for voice.engine openclaw. Native ElevenLabs only via voice.engine deepgram-agent; requires tts.apiKey and tts.voice (Voice-ID). Custom requires model, base URL and Voice-ID.

enabled.label: Enable SIP
enabled.help: Channel values override legacy plugins.entries.sip.config. Migrate existing config before first channel edit.

providerPresets.label: Provider presets
providerPresets.help: Optional defaults per provider. Explicit STT/TTS fields override these values. Switching provider selects its preset only for omitted fields.

stt.model.label: STT model
stt.model.help: Suggestions: nova-3, nova-2. Custom model/deployment IDs remain supported; SDK has no editable dropdown hint.

tts.model.label: TTS model
tts.model.help: Suggestions: aura-2-viktoria-de, aura-2-thalia-en, eleven_multilingual_v2, eleven_flash_v2_5, eleven_turbo_v2_5. Custom model/deployment IDs remain supported; SDK has no editable dropdown hint.

stt.baseUrl.label: STT base URL
stt.baseUrl.help: WSS base URL; /v1/listen appended. Explicit value overrides preset.

tts.baseUrl.label: TTS base URL
tts.baseUrl.help: HTTPS base URL; provider API path appended. Custom requires an explicit URL.

voice.engine.label: Voice assistant mode
voice.engine.help: openclaw uses inbound.agentId with STT/TTS; its LLM is configured in OpenClaw. deepgram-agent uses its own LLM and prompt; supports native ElevenLabs TTS.

voice.agent.prompt.label: Agent system prompt
voice.agent.prompt.help: System prompt for the Deepgram Voice Agent (voice.engine deepgram-agent).

voice.agent.think.model.label: LLM
voice.agent.think.model.help: Model ID for voice.engine deepgram-agent only; not the OpenClaw agent's model. Managed models: GET https://agent.deepgram.com/v1/agent/settings/think/models

inbound.toolsAllow.label: Allowed phone tools
inbound.toolsAllow.help: Tool names the phone agent may call. Empty = no tools.

voice.agent.tools.label: Agent tools via OpenClaw
voice.agent.tools.help: Lets the Deepgram agent delegate tasks to the OpenClaw agent.

inbound.pin.label: Keypad PIN (DTMF)
inbound.pin.help: Protects the phone agent and its MCP tools behind a keypad PIN entry.

inbound.pin.enabled.label: Enable PIN gate
inbound.pin.enabled.help: Requires a keypad PIN (DTMF) before the agent or its tools can be reached.

inbound.pin.code.label: PIN code
inbound.pin.code.help: Digits only (3-12). Entered on the phone keypad, confirmed with the pound key (#).

inbound.pin.promptText.label: PIN prompt announcement
inbound.pin.promptText.help: Text spoken to prompt for PIN entry.

inbound.pin.failureText.label: Incorrect PIN announcement
inbound.pin.failureText.help: Text played after a wrong PIN entry.

inbound.pin.successText.label: Correct PIN announcement (optional)
inbound.pin.successText.help: Optionaler Bestaetigungstext vor der eigentlichen Greeting.

inbound.pin.lockoutText.label: Lockout announcement
inbound.pin.lockoutText.help: Text played when too many attempts failed, before the call is hung up.
